title: Allocation Multiplicity: Evaluating the Promises of the Rashomon Set
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of faith or religion. The analysis focuses on algorithmic fairness, specifically allocation multiplicity and model multiplicity in a healthcare context, using race and age as the primary axes of analysis.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
